issues.title: Oak Avenue traffic calming
issues.summary: Residents requested raised crossings and a 20 mph zone after three documented near-misses. Funding was approved, but installation has moved twice.

issues.title: Old Quarry rezoning
issues.summary: A 180-unit proposal seeks a height variance near the former quarry. Planning staff requested a revised traffic study before council consideration.

issues.title: East Branch library hours
issues.summary: A pilot to restore Sunday hours cleared the budget committee and awaits its public launch schedule.

events.summary: Public Works moved construction to spring 2027, citing a utility conflict discovered during final design.
Council approved $410,000 for final design and construction by a 6–1 vote.
Transportation committee selected raised crossings over speed humps after emergency-access review.
A petition with 286 signatures requested an engineering study and interim speed feedback signs.
Planning Commission set a continued hearing for December 8 after requesting a revised traffic study.
Developer filed a rezoning and height-variance application for 180 residential units.
Budget committee funded a six-month Sunday-hours pilot beginning in January.
